title: Chapter 755
paragraphs: Chapter 755
Episode 185. The Remaining People (5)
Jin swallowed a sigh, thinking about the life of the person named Padler.
A thousand years ago, the Thunder King, who had defended Runcandel as the 10th knight, was now a monster locked in the family's underground dungeon.
"How's his condition?"
"...Not good."
"Let's go see him right away. The knights will follow me, the rest of you disband and do your jobs."
The underground dungeon was located on the opposite side of the mausoleum. Jin paused briefly in front of it as he passed by.

Just as the Garden of Swords was intact, the mausoleum also looked exactly the same as before. Many ancestors were exiled due to the Shrine of the Evil God, but the mausoleum was still the backbone of the family.
"My sister, and my brothers."
When Jin called them by these personal terms, his siblings looked much lighter.
"Yeah, our youngest."
"Let's resemble our ancestors who fought to the end, even in death."
Padler was in the lowest floor, in the room where Joshua had fallen in the past.
Seeing him, Jin frowned.
He had heard in advance that the condition was not good, but it was much worse than expected. From about half a dozen fist-sized holes in his body, a soul force was spurting out like blood.
It was a trace of a fierce battle with Bale. The Tona brothers informed him that Padler had left the battlefield during the last battle and had a separate showdown with Bale.
The result was Bale's complete victory. Padler did fight back, but Bale had never lost to him since he was active.
Still, there was one reason Bale did not extinguish Padler.
The existence of chains.

Jin was looking at the chain binding Padler's heart, inside the hole in his chest. Bale recognized it during the battle and decided to spare Padler for the time being. Though this could hardly be considered a 'survived' state.
"Sir Padler."
The chain binding his heart was already half broken. Looking down at him, Jin's feelings were mixed.
Padler, too, was just another fallen ancestor in the end.
However, it was not only the power of the Evil God that worked in his fall. Even before his soul was tied to his heart, he already had a deep hatred for Temar.
[You have arrived.]
"You're forcing yourself to withstand the extinction."
[Yes. Recovery or resurrection is impossible.]
"Do you have any regrets left?"
[Nothing like that. I just had something to say to you before disappearing from the world.]
"What do you want to talk about?"
[A story from the past...]
Padler gave a faint smile.
He wouldn't make a pathetic excuse for survival. The two eyes Jin was looking at were already filled with the emptiness typical of a person who had given up on life.
"What I wanted was not the revival of Runcandel, but corruption and destruction... When we first met, you said that to me. I hope your thoughts have changed."

-I don't know everything that happened a thousand years ago, Sir Padler. And the point I wanted to make by mentioning the names of Sir Silderay and Sarah was not that you should have resembled them... I just wanted to say that it seemed like you and they cared a lot for each other. That's probably before the fall of the Lunar Kingdom in your memory.
[A once harmonious heart can't replace all that I've lost.]
The conversation I had with Padler during the first total offensive.
At that time, Padler said he didn't remember any other past except for Temar destroying the Lunar Kingdom, and he didn't want to.
[The truth does not change. The fact that Temar obliterated my kingdom without leaving a trace... It does not change.]
Black tears flowed from Padler's eyes. He was recalling the day Temar destroyed the Lunar Kingdom.
[However, as the Evil God was dying, one more memory came up. A truth I had forgotten.]
"A truth?"
[The reason why Temar went mad. There was someone who turned him, who was the hope of the family and the world, into a monster full of madness. There was a traitor in the family.]
Jin's eyes widened.
"…Who was it?"
[Lokia. Lokia, Ganesto.]
Padler spat the name out.

[He was the traitor... He joined hands with the witch and turned Temar into a monster. Everything was Lokia's plot. Even Solderet leaving Temar for a while, the gods betraying us, and Zipfel's rise to power.]
-Lord, no! Big brother. It won't work out. I'll go see that witch in the Black Sea once. Lokia said so, if she's a witch, she might have some way. To stop Zipfel's history manipulation...
The conversation between Sarah and Temar from the past third tomb came to mind.
At the time, Temar lied to Sarah as if he could persuade the gods, and Sarah intended to meet Lokia secretly against his dissuasion.
"Please tell me more in detail."

[Before he killed me, Lokia said his goal was the resurrection of the Sun God. That's why he killed all his comrades and spared only Bale. He intended to completely erase the current world and restore the rightful world. The original form of the world, he said. For that, he used everything, the family, the witch, even Zipfel.]
"There are those who still say the same thing today."

["Perhaps the Demon King Orgal. He too, must have been tricked. The erasure of the Demon King from history was also Loki's doing. Even the birth of this abomination, there's a high likelihood that Loki was involved."]
"How can you be so sure?"

["Because the abomination is a descendant of Ganesto's bloodline. I was only able to confirm it after the chains of the heart were loosened. That he himself was of Ganesto's bloodline was a recent revelation to the abomination as well. But he likely was not aware of Loki's interference."]
The reason why Padler knew this was because he had spent a long time observing the abomination's inner world.
["If it hadn't been for Loki, if only he hadn't betrayed us. There would have been no reason for Temar to go mad, for my kingdom to disappear, for my comrades, for Sarah to die in such a way...!"]
Choking!
Padler shuddered as he spat out his words, his breath beginning to falter, which he had forcibly held back until Jin arrived.
"Sir Padler!"
["All I can remember is this... I blamed Temar so much, but in the end, I was played by the same trick, threatened the clan and... turned into a monster that killed many people."]
Padler grabbed Jin's shoulder.
["Jin Runcandel. The reason why I held on to reveal the truth is because I thought you could break this cursed chain...! Loki Ganesto, that demon, he is surely still alive."]
The holes in Padler's body were slowly getting bigger. Disappearance was looming.

["He received eternal life from the witch. With my own eyes, I saw Loki resurrect several times. We couldn't kill Loki, not with the clan's sword, not with Elona's magic! You must find Loki, you must not be tricked by him!"]
Padler's eyes, which were touching Jin's, were disappearing into the darkness.
Now... me too, to Sarah, to the clan and comrades...
With that final word, Padler completely disappeared.
For a while, Jin and his brothers stared at the empty space where Padler had vanished.
"So all of this... all of it originated from a betrayal a thousand years ago?"
"If the abomination was used by the traitor, then Qwaul, our youngest, could Qwaul also be being used by Loki?"
"Qwaul also said he only recently found out he's of Ganesto's bloodline."
Soon, the brothers Mary and Tona were the first to speak.
"It doesn't seem likely that Sir Padler would lie at this point, but there are inconsistencies. If Loki was the traitor, then why was he perfectly erased from history until recently?"
"That part could be assumed that Loki used Zipfel's history manipulation to protect himself. The stranger part is, Loki schemed against Orgal, who had the same goal."
"That's how it is..."
"The important thing is Loki's identity and whether he's alive. If he's alive, and the fact that he is really a traitor is revealed, we'll have to find him and punish him as Sir Padler said."
We can't fully trust everything Padler said yet. Not because we doubt him, but because there's no guarantee that his memory is perfect.
But if all of Padler's stories are true, Loki has been the biggest villain manipulating the world for the past thousand years. Even now, he is still reaching out his devilish hand.
"We're lacking too much information, so we'll take this issue step by step. First, let's stabilize the situation and prepare for the enemies we can see."
When he opened the prison door, he saw Bale leaning against the wall. Jin knew he had been eavesdropping on the conversation while leaning against the wall.
"You shouldn't just walk in here without my permission, Bale."
"I know, but as a former knight, can't you understand that much?"
"That's why I just spoke."
"...What he said is probably all true."
"Did you know?"

"No. Padler was an unfortunate guy, but his feelings towards the clan and Sarah were real. If what he said is true, then Sarah's enemy is Loki. I'll definitely find him, along with Zipfel, and I will make sure they suffer before they die."
"Do you remember anything about Loki?"

"He was a mysterious guy. I never thought he would be a traitor, but it's true that Loki had a lot of interactions with the witch. However, I don't know anything about his actions after I was sealed. Oh, come to think of it... Loki was the one who insisted the most on sealing me instead of killing me."
"Got it. If you remember anything special, let me know right away."
"But what are you going to do with Padler's belongings?"
"Belongings?"
"Silus. His sword."
Padler's sword was currently stored in the warehouse.
"As an old comrade, give me your opinion. What should we do?"
"We can't just put it in the tomb or stick it in the garden right now."
"Right. Whatever his circumstances were, Sir Padler killed many people."
"At the end, he deliberately drew me out to fight so he wouldn't kill others. But I also know it's a hard story to sell."
Bale had hated Padler, but he was strangely emotional now that he had regained his sanity and disappeared.
They had always quarreled over Sarah, but there was a time when they were comrades.

"...So don't give his sword to anyone, just keep it. And if later it's revealed that everything Padler said is true. And because of that, if the clan regains its former glory. Then how about putting it in the tomb then. If not in the tomb, then in the garden. Please."
Jin looked at Bale and replied.
"Let's do that."
